dedupe_keys.name: bnpe french national database of water abstractions

description: The French water information system produced the BNPE, the national database of quantitative water abstractions, searchable by commune, département or region and by period, with a data log, a toolbox and a page explaining which data users can access. The abstractions are fed in by the bodies listed on the site. Coverage is France. The data are free to access and download under the etalab-2.0 open licence. Caveats: the home page does not state the years covered or the abstraction size threshold, and third-party content may carry other rights. Simulation uses: abstraction volumes by use for water resource and drought planning. Related records: England's ENV15 abstraction tables (data-defra-env15-water-abstraction-england).
